details.review_text: Synthetic public G4 first-slice technical plan and frozen completion contract fixed at package commit 2b7ad3eec9b25a79c2a458de5aebd318366a9ea4; decision Issue #6 (stable ID 5542567278, https://github.com/cscra/factory-control-records/issues/6) was created by ordinary Agent yuhuan54880470 (ID 330810629) for page setup only and carries no Human decision authority; only a later exact decision comment by yuhuan0669 (ID 31118604) can decide G4. A valid G4 approval may authorize BUILD-SLICE@R1 / IMPLEMENT_SLICE for the described first slice only; it does not accept the implementation result, release later batches or G5/G6, deploy the sample, use real business data, adopt Control, or approve the separate 30-to-70-percent change.
